displayProcessing.conditioning: Worker removes the selected event-window mean, applies an edge taper and a 35-350 Hz FFT-domain band pass.
displayProcessing.spectrogram: Worker STFT of the conditioned released detector strain.
displayProcessing.comparison: Leading-order PN strain is an optional amber overlay only.

interpretation: The cyan waveform and spectrogram originate from GWOSC measured strain. The amber PN trace is an optional computed comparison.
citation: Abbott, B.P. et al., 2021. Open data from the first and second observing runs of Advanced LIGO and Advanced Virgo. SoftwareX, 13, 100658.
